items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And so we went with him. Vernon Brown, myself, Nick Fatool, Les Robinson.

ctx.x: That’s a great story. You got into producing?

Well I went with Artie Shaw. Benny broke the band up in Catalina Island in 1940, to have his back operated on. He says I don’t know when I’m coming back, it may be in the fall or something like that. This was summertime. And he said, “I’ll call you.” But meanwhile, all six of us joined Artie Shaw, the day after we left Catalina he was waiting for us. He was organizing his new band. He had a band that he was out on record, with strings, the twelve strings, but they were studio musicians, they were all studio-type…
swing band. It was playing swing with strings. But to me that was sort of a heavy feel for an improviser. You know you wanted to play against a Kansas City four-four.
